The real SQLite case at `hub/tests/tools/test_gateway.py:168` proves that the missing turn/call audit registration aborts a denial, not that a functioning gateway commits its audit. This fails E12-01/02/03, SYSTEM 5.12 and E12 sections 4, 5 and 15. Required change: complete the owned adapters and module factories/bindings against the real published owner ports, register the mandatory checks and obtain the shared audit/reference binding. Bind the pinned catalog, vocabulary, tokenizer, prompt serialization, authorized projections and controller effect boundary. Add a real composition test proving positive authorized calls, committed safe denials and optional-provider unavailability. Implement the remaining question, proposal, read and calculation families required by the design; missing providers remain explicit acceptance dependencies, never fabricated implementations or permanent feature removal. Keep E13 routes, E28 plan handlers and provider storage in their owners.

3. [blocker] The gateway accepts structurally wrong and unsafe handler data without the required semantic validation. `hub/src/crew_health/tools/application/gateway.py:156` checks only generic JSON shape/size and ToolResult metadata. It does not validate a tool-specific result schema, support eligibility or the output policy. Admission at line 116 also has no argument-aware object/field authorization or domain policy stage; ScopeAuthority receives only scope. `hub/src/crew_health/tools/application/policy_service.py:40` checks shared text matches and exact tuple membership, but never invokes the warning predicate, guidance/plan/help guards or typed support verification. `require_warning_authority` has no production caller. Result is `ok` with all those bytes preserved. This does not itself clear a warning, but it violates the closed typed result and failed-value exclusion requirements before any controller uses it. Required change: validate arguments and each result against the pinned per-tool contract and authorized owner projection, apply support restrictions, and integrate the complete mandatory policy/owner guards before effects or output can leave the stage. Require those bindings for positive acceptance. Preserve storage/auth/config errors. Add regressions for wrong-tool payloads, finite failed numerical canaries, foreign references, nested forbidden text and warning/help/plan actions, plus independent owner-state assertions.

4. [blocker] Deadline and policy limits are not enforced as specified. `hub/src/crew_health/tools/application/gateway.py:139` invokes the handler first, then compares only this call's duration with the original deadline.duration. The deadline anchor is never examined and duration is incorrectly called remaining. Each call gets that full allowance again. Reviewer reproduction: move the existing one-second scope deadline anchor back one day; execute returns `ok` and the handler runs once. A hung handler is also never interrupted by the post-return check. Lines 50 and 51 read only HubSettings; the stricter pinned assistant-policy iteration and timeout limits are never consulted. The current budget test explicitly accepts 32 calls although the package policy example limits iterations to 8. Required change: consume the shared correction-aware deadline/lease authority before dispatch and after completion, intersect actual remaining time, tool/turn settings and pinned policy limits, and enforce external cancellation in the owner adapter outside a writer transaction. Unknown/expired time must prevent execution. Test expired anchors, accumulated calls, forward/backward corrections, process epoch changes, cancellation, hanging providers and a policy limit lower than the hub ceiling. Do not implement another scheduler or clock algorithm.

The corrected import run identifies these four contracts: intake-independent-records, tools-independent-config, tools-independent-knowledge and tools-independent-measurement. E12's direct imports use the application ports; the forbidden paths are transitive through their provider implementations/types. Resolve that architectural seam with the owners, not by ignoring the import contract or copying their domain implementation into E12.

Reproduction details for findings 3 to 5 and 7: reviewer-only inline Python ran under `uv run --project hub --locked python`, imported the existing component test factories, and made no source edits. The gateway probe replaced the one-second deadline anchor with a time one day before `View.now` and observed `ok`, handler_calls 1. A separate fresh gateway returned the exact rejected-reading/warning payload quoted in finding 3 as `ok`. PublicQueryBoundary accepted each forbidden vocabulary entry quoted in finding 5. The history probe used the actual EvidenceQueryService with 51 superseded memberships named evr_00 through evr_50; E10 returned InReleaseHistory for evr_50 and one row after cursor evr_49, while E12 raised CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.
